name: The Good Loop
thesis: A nocturnal editorial field guide to Raygen: an oversized serif thought opens onto a precise triangular relationship between learning, making, and passing knowledge on. Deep plum chapters connect a personal letter, physical machines, software, and the people around them.
interaction: Choose Learn it, Make it, or Pass it on to trace a different side of the triangle and switch the real artwork and personal context. Arrow keys, Home, and End also navigate the three states; the complete story continues below.
why: The purple atmosphere and intimate letter develop the user's favorite personal qualities, while the object typography returns later around SERV0. One Stone tooling and safety, VEX shop responsibility, Stardance pull requests, and Outpost support make teaching and shared understanding central to the portrait.
